## Recent Blog Posts

- [How Many Magical Servitors Can You Actually Work With?](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/how-many-servitors-you-can-actually-work-with.html): The real limit on the number of servitors you can run is your nervous system, not your notebook. A protocol for finding your own ceiling safely.
- [The Neural Grimoire: Chaos Magic and Brain Reprogramming](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/neural-grimoire-reprogramming-your-brain-chaos-magic.html): Reprogramming is a software metaphor borrowed by a brain that has no source code. What survives the borrowing, and what the plastic parts actually respond to.
- [Magical Servants for Beginners: Theory and Practice](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/magical-servants-for-beginners-theory-practice-gap.html): Most beginner guides split theory from practice and never reconnect them. Here is what the theory half quietly assumes, and what a first month actually looks like.
- [The Witch-King: A Chaos Magick Servitor Guide](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/witch-king-servitor-authority-not-wishes.html): The witch-king is three different things wearing one name. Here is which one you can actually build, what a servant is for, and the design sheet for an adjudicator rather than a genie.
- [How to Become a Chaos Magick Practitioner: 90-Day Plan](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/become-a-chaos-magick-practitioner-90-day-plan.html): What separates a chaos magician from someone who reads about chaos magic, a week-by-week ninety day plan, the four-field log that makes it real, and the three reasons people stall.
- [Sigil Craft: How to Choose a Reduction Family](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/sigil-craft-choosing-a-reduction-family.html): Four sigil traditions are in circulation and they optimise for different things. A framework for picking the one that fits the work, and the cost you accept when you do.
- [Ice Magic: The Coldness Practice and Its Consent Test](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/ice-magic-coldness-attraction-practice-explained.html): The cold-attraction branch is the most ethically loaded thing in this whole channel. What the mechanism actually is, why the most reliable version of it is unintended, and the test that decides whether to build it at all.
- [Building Your First Chaos Magic Servitor: A Design](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/build-your-first-chaos-magic-servitor.html): The first servitor is not a spirit, it is a written specification that has to survive contact with an ordinary Tuesday. The design, the refusal clause, and the first review.
- [Hyper-Accelerated Sigils: What the Claim Survives](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/hyper-accelerated-sigils-what-the-claim-survives.html): The acceleration claim comes from Spare's late sigil work. Here is which part of it holds up under a real test, which part is an artefact of compressing the wrong interval, and what stacking actually costs.
- [How Does Chaos Magic of Money Work? Mechanism Audit](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/chaos-magic-of-money-mechanism-audit.html): An itemised audit of what would have to be true for money magic to work: nine links in the causal chain, which are ordinary, which are unfalsifiable, and which are testable this month.
- [How Many Chaos Magic Servitors Can You Run?](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/how-many-chaos-magic-servitors-you-can-run.html): What changes at 1, 5, 15 and 25 servitors: the honest capacity limit is not magical, the bookkeeping limit is real, and the collection is the failure mode.
- [Practical Planetary Magic: A Seven-Day Frame](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/practical-planetary-magic-seven-day-frame.html): The seven classical planets as a working calendar: what each day is actually good for, where the planetary hours are worth the effort, and the honest mechanism underneath.
- [How Puck Became the Demon of Modern Witchcraft](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/how-puck-became-the-demon-of-modern-witchcraft.html): Puck went from a shapeshifting hobgoblin in A Midsummer Night's Dream to Puck, the Demon, in 1740. Here is the actual chain, and what each step changed.
- [Inner Power in Chaos Magick: What the Claim Is](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/chaos-magic-inner-power-what-the-phrase-claims.html): Inner power is the most over-claimed phrase in modern occult marketing. Here is a reference breakdown of the four different things it can mean, which versions survive scrutiny, and how to tell which one you are being sold.
- [Secrets of Money in Chaos Magick: A Claim Audit](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/secrets-of-money-with-chaos-magic-claim-audit.html): Every money ritual in circulation is hiding something, and it is rarely the trick. Here is a field audit of the standard claims, sorted into four categories, with the useful residue in each kept.
- [Pacts with Mammon: A Complete Goetic Wealth Guide](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/mammon-wealth-pact-guide.html): Mammon is the Biblical spirit of accumulation, not of evil. What a wealth pact actually is, why the ban on it is a usury ban, and how to work one safely.
- [Clauneck Ars Goetia: Arts, Sciences and Wealth](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/clauneck-ars-goetia-arts-sciences-guide.html): Clauneck is a President of the 72 who grants arts, sciences and invisibility, and who finds hidden things. A close reading of his office, plus why the wealth rituals attached to his name are a later habit.
- [The Clauneck Wealth Ritual, Reviewed Honestly](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/clauneck-wealth-ritual-critique-guide.html): Stripped of its framing, the Clauneck wealth ritual is a sigil, a charge, a timing choice and a defined action. Here is what is real, what fails, and what to write down first.
- [Three Real Goetic Workings, Honestly Tested](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/three-real-goetic-workings-tested.html): Three Goetic workings built from named Ars Goetia clauses, each with a measurement, a pre-written stop condition, and the false positive named in advance.
- [Stolas, Prince of the Spirits of the Eagle: Guide](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/stolas-prince-of-spirits-eagle-guide.html): Stolas is one of the few Goetia spirits described as straightforwardly useful: astronomy, herbs, stones, tides, and wealth. What his text actually says, where the translations go wrong, and how to work with him.
- [Clauneck Wealth Ritual: A Beginner's Order of Operations](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/clauneck-wealth-ritual-beginners-order-of-operations.html): A beginner's sequencing guide to Clauneck wealth work: what to build first, what to skip entirely, and how to write a target you can actually falsify.
- [Eight Weeks of Clauneck Pact Work: An Honest Log](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/clauneck-wealth-pact-field-log-eight-weeks.html): A documented eight-week run of Clauneck wealth pact work: six logged workings, every number kept, the two that failed and the one that cost money.
- [Austin Osman Spare: Magic of Disorder, Critiqued](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/austin-osman-spare-magic-of-disorder-critique.html): Spare's sigil method is usually taught as letter-stripping. What he actually wrote in 1909 says something stranger, and his own scepticism cuts against the causal claims made in his name.
- [BUNE, Executor of Intentions: Clause Reference](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/bune-executor-of-intentions-reference.html): The Ars Goetia entry for BUNE says he executes the intentions of others. That is not a wealth clause, and reading it as one is where these pacts break.
- [Gnosis: A Four-Question Protocol for Verification](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/blog/gnosis-protocol-four-questions.html): Gnosis is routinely confused with intensity, self-confirmation and vivid imagination. Four questions, applied in order, separate them reliably.

## Atomic Tools (40 herramientas gratuitas)

Estas páginas son herramientas estáticas, gratuitas y orientativas. Funcionan en el navegador, no sustituyen asesoramiento profesional y no deben interpretarse como predicciones. Los datos introducidos se procesan localmente por el motor de cada página.

## Technical Notes

- **Language:** Primary English (EN), some Spanish (ES) for activador-servidores
- **Canonical URLs:** `https://cha0smagicklabs.com/` with `.html` suffix on all pages
- **Schema types:** SoftwareApplication, WebApplication, FAQPage, QAPage, HowTo, Article, ContactPoint, AggregateRating
- **Sitemap:** [sitemap.xml](https://cha0smagicklabs.com/sitemap.xml)
- **CSS:** Shared minified stylesheet (`style.min.css`) plus independent `atomic-tools.css` for the new tools
- **JS:** Shared bundles (`app-render.min.js`, `apps-data.min.js`, `visitor-map.min.js`, `shared.min.js`) plus independent `atomic-tools.js` for the new tools
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics G-V6LHCPN9TK (privacy-first, denied by default)
- **Theme:** Dark theme, mobile-responsive
